title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Datasheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Datasheet
options.thesis: Each persona is published as a part's datasheet: numbered sections, a device-information table, a revision footer.
options.viewport: A 6px route-colour band under the nav, the name as the part title with a device-information table beside it, then numbered Introduction, Links and Experience sections.
options.risk: Tips into corporate paperwork if the tables get dense or the numbering is applied to everything.

raised.raise: State is a mark, not a hue: active nav, current route and external links are marked by notch, rule or glyph; no third colour ever enters.
One swipe per view: the route accent marks only the band and the single active state on a screen, never decoration.
One governing module: a 4px baseline and one label-column width align every heading, table and list.
One vertical axis: dates and counts sit in a fixed tabular-mono column at the left of every list, so the eye runs one line down the site.
Rules are the grid made visible: every hairline starts and ends on a column line; none are ornamental.

options.label: Man page
options.thesis: The home page is JOHNJIN(1): NAME, SYNOPSIS, DESCRIPTION, EXPERIENCE, SEE ALSO.
materials: bold and underline as the only emphasis
options.viewport: Running head JOHNJIN(1) across the top, then NAME and a one-line SYNOPSIS of links, DESCRIPTION intro and EXPERIENCE as indented entries.
options.risk: This is where most developer sites land; easy to read as a terminal costume.

options.label: Software manual tab board
options.lineage: Boxed-software reference manuals with coloured divider tabs
options.thesis: The site is a manual open at a tabbed divider; Official and Casual are two tabs on the fore edge, each a board of its own hue.
materials: dark leaf over a hue board
options.viewport: A dark leaf holds the profile; the route hue shows at the margins and as a tab rail down the right edge naming Home, Articles, Photos, Tags.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and the tab rail makes the two routes obvious (holds clarity); fewer readers recognise boxed manuals than datasheets.
options.risk: A full-strength hue board strains the constrained palette and reads nostalgic.

options.label: Crouwel grid specimen
options.thesis: Name built cell by cell on a visible construction grid.
options.viewport: A monumental grid-built name over a faint construction grid.
options.case: Reads as a design portfolio, not a programmer's site; display type competes with the intro.
options.kept: Rules are the grid made visible.

options.label: Mesophotic deep dive
options.thesis: Experience as a descent down one depth axis.
options.viewport: Career as a vertical dive profile.
options.case: No link between diving and the subject; the metaphor costs clarity.
options.kept: One vertical axis rules every list.

options.label: Cutting bench select rail
options.thesis: Sections strung as frames along a perforated rail.
options.viewport: A scrubbing strip of frames across the page.
options.case: Scrub navigation is something a reader must learn; orange holding a third of the screen fights simplicity.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a hue.

options.label: Hand-drawn zine
options.thesis: Concepts taught with marker doodles and mascots.
options.viewport: A doodled diagram under a marker headline.
options.case: Cream ground and multiple highlighters break the dark, constrained brief.

options.label: Drawcord cape
options.thesis: One cord pulls a flat plane into form.
options.viewport: A black semicircle with a single gold cord.
options.case: No audience link; the transformation metaphor has nothing to transform here.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dark developer portfolio: centred column, name, bio, icon links, experience list.
canonCard.viewport: Name and one-line role, short bio, a row of icon links, then experience entries in soft cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from thousands of other developer sites by design.
